items.text: We have our own millwork shop and team of carpenters & finishers.
We specialize in fast paced schedules and high end interior finishes.
We know what it takes to bring in a project on time and on budget.
Our 10 million dollar GL insurance policy can qualify us to work in almost every building in the city and 5 boros.
We can provide pricing for most projects in 7 working days.
items.note: Keep the qualifier 'most'. Architects notice overclaims (DESIGN §1).
